item.title: Saudi Arabia said to intensify talks with Iran to defuse Mideast war
item.description: Reported outreach comes as Islamic Republicn continues to attack its neighbors; officials from several Gulf states complain they weren't given earlier notice about initial US-Israeli strikes The post Saudi Arabia said to intensify talks with Iran to defuse Mideast war appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: IDF says underground missile factory, other key sites hit in Iran; multiple missile salvos fired at Israel

item.title: ‘Knew they were next’: Hezbollah rearmed for months after concluding war inevitable
item.description: Sources tell Reuters that terror group relied on $50m monthly budget largely supplied by Iran, its own weapons factories in Lebanon to ready for latest round of fighting with IDF The post ‘Knew they were next’: Hezbollah rearmed for months after concluding war inevitable appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Heartbreak in Kuwait as 11-year-old Iranian girl killed in Iran drone attack
item.description: Elena Abdullah Hussein's father says his daughter was sleeping at home when she was fatally struck by shrapnel: 'She was a blessing from God' The post Heartbreak in Kuwait as 11-year-old Iranian girl killed in Iran drone attack appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Two UN peacekeepers from Ghana critically hurt in Lebanon missile attack
item.description: Ghanian military says officers' mess 'burnt down completely' after base was hit; UNIFIL investigating source of fire, which Lebanese president blames on Israel The post Two UN peacekeepers from Ghana critically hurt in Lebanon missile attack appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Mamdani’s wife liked posts celebrating Oct. 7

item.title: Florida politicians slam Miami Young Republican leaders over antisemitic group chat
